record.title: Covered stablecoin issuer reserve policy
kv: NYDFS stablecoin guidance sets backing, custody, segregation and liquidity conditions for covered issuers.
A DFS-supervised issuer maintains backing assets; where Circle Reserve Fund is used, its disclosed manager manages fund investments and operations.
DFS-supervised stablecoin issuers subject to the guidance, acting through properly appointed reserve providers

Identify the covered issuer and approved product. Establish the reserve policy, permitted assets, segregation, custody and reporting arrangements. Separate issuer policy responsibility from the fund manager and custodian appointments.
This covered-issuer policy route does not itself appoint an investment manager or prove any entity’s current product approval.

sources.label: NYDFS Guidance on the Issuance of U.S. Dollar-Backed Stablecoins
